dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Strongly concave trailing edge exhibiting a smooth, continuous curvature from the posterior insertion point to the sub-apical region.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded apex with a broad pixel radius, lacking acute angularity.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Moderately steep convex margin, approximately 45 degrees relative to the visible dorsal midline.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Wide-based morphology where the horizontal pixel span at the base exceeds the vertical height from base to apex by approximately 1.5:1.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Cluster of high-contrast white linear and punctate markings, consistent with rake marks, located on the dorsal-lateral surface of the caudal peduncle near the fluke insertion.
other_distinctive_markers: Visible tail fluke with a deep median notch and smooth, recurved trailing edges.
